_readme: Curated free courses (part 2 of 2) — data analytics, AI/ML, UI/UX, digital marketing.

entries.title: Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate
entries.description: Spreadsheets, SQL, R, and Tableau — Google's job-ready data analytics program (audit free).

entries.title: IBM Data Analyst Professional Certificate
entries.description: Excel, Python, SQL, and Cognos Analytics with hands-on labs and a capstone (audit free).

entries.title: SQL for Data Science
entries.description: SELECTs, joins, subqueries, and data-shaping queries used in real analytics work.

entries.title: Excel Skills for Business Specialization
entries.description: Spreadsheet basics to advanced dashboards and Power Query — the most popular Excel program online.

entries.title: Data Analysis with Python
entries.description: NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, and Seaborn — certification projects on real datasets.

entries.title: PostgreSQL Tutorial (Official)
entries.description: The database team's own SQL tutorial — queries, joins, aggregates, views and transactions.

entries.title: Fundamentals of Data Visualization (free ebook)
entries.description: Free ebook on making honest, readable charts — scales, colour, layout and common pitfalls.

entries.title: Khan Academy — Statistics & Probability
entries.description: Distributions, significance tests, and regression — the math foundation every analyst needs.

entries.title: The Analytics Edge (MIT)
entries.description: Real analytics cases — sports, finance, and public health — solved with R and optimization.

entries.title: Introduction to Computational Thinking and Data Science
entries.description: MIT 6.0002 — stochastic thinking, Monte Carlo simulation, clustering, and ML intro.

entries.title: Introduction to Data Analytics (IBM)
entries.description: The analytics ecosystem, data roles, and the analysis workflow — a clean first step into data.

entries.title: Machine Learning Specialization
entries.description: Andrew Ng's updated classic — regression, classification, decision trees, and unsupervised learning.

entries.title: Deep Learning Specialization
entries.description: Neural networks, CNNs, RNNs, Transformers — the program that trained a generation of ML engineers.

entries.title: CS50's Introduction to Artificial Intelligence with Python
entries.description: Search, knowledge, uncertainty, optimization, learning, and neural networks — with Python projects.

entries.title: An Introduction to Statistical Learning
entries.description: The free ISLR textbook with R and Python labs — regression, classification trees and more.

entries.title: Dive into Deep Learning (D2L)
entries.description: Interactive deep learning book with runnable PyTorch, TensorFlow and JAX code on every page.

entries.title: Machine Learning with Python
entries.description: TensorFlow certification track — classification, NLP, reinforcement learning, and neural nets.

entries.title: Google AI Essentials
entries.description: Use generative AI tools responsibly at work — prompting, augmenting, and evaluating outputs.

entries.title: Linear Algebra (MIT 18.06)
entries.description: Gilbert Strang's legendary course — the linear algebra behind every ML model.

entries.title: Google UX Design Professional Certificate
entries.description: UX research, wireframing, and Figma prototyping — build a portfolio of 3 complete app designs.

entries.title: UI/UX Design Specialization
entries.description: Visual design fundamentals — grids, typography, color, and interface composition from CalArts.

entries.title: Interaction Design Specialization
entries.description: Human-centered design research, prototyping, and usability testing — UCSD's design track.

entries.title: Figma — Official Learn Guides
entries.description: Official tutorials for the industry-standard design tool — frames, components, auto-layout, prototyping.

entries.title: Digital Marketing Specialization
entries.description: SEO, social media, and real market cases — Illinois' marketing strategy track.

entries.title: Google Digital Marketing & E-commerce Certificate
entries.description: Email, ads, SEO, and analytics for online stores — Google's entry-level marketing certificate.

entries.title: Social Media Marketing Specialization
entries.description: Specialization on organic and paid social strategy, audience analytics and ad campaigns (audit free).

entries.title: Google Skillshop — Ads & Analytics Training
entries.description: Google's official free courses and certifications for Ads, Analytics and Marketing Platform.
